title: Stop bids going below your floor

steps.caption: Settings
steps.narration: A price floor stops your team from bidding below the prices you set.

steps.caption: Price floor lock
steps.narration: In Settings, scroll down to Price floor lock. Only the owner sees this card.

steps.caption: What the floor is
steps.narration: The floor is the current price of each item in your price book.

steps.caption: Or a margin over cost
steps.narration: Or type a margin here, to set the floor at cost plus that percent.

steps.caption: A sales rep's screen
steps.narration: Now a sales rep's screen. Priya is writing a new estimate.

steps.caption: Wrenhaven Dental Studio
steps.narration: Wrenhaven Dental Studio, in White Plains.

steps.caption: Search the price book
steps.narration: And searches the price book for the work.

steps.caption: Add the item
steps.narration: The item comes in at its price book price.

steps.caption: A lower price
steps.narration: To win the job, she types a lower price.

steps.caption: Refused
steps.narration: The CRM refuses. The message names the item, and the floor it cannot go below.

steps.caption: The owner is not locked
steps.narration: Back on your own screen. As the owner, you can still change prices and discounts at any time.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: Price floor lock is in Settings, near the bottom of the left menu.

youtube.title: How to stop bids going below your price floor | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Protect your margin in the ConstructHUB CRM. Switch on Price floor lock in Settings and your team can price at or above your price book, never below. See what a sales rep sees when an estimate goes under the floor. Recorded in a demo workspace.
